text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The colors dissolve...
And the paintbrush remains in slumber...
Normally, an abstract painting expressing her love for racing would be drawn there, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even if my heart races...
it's all for naught if the only color that flashes is white...

Mejiro Ramonu might be feeling fatigued.
I should probably reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
